title: SiteOps Engineer
description:
**Why Choose TD SYNNEX**
As a Fortune 500 global technology distributor operating in over 100 countries, TD SYNNEX connects the world's leading technology vendors with thousands of partners and customers. With over 22,000 employees globally, we support complex digital platforms that power critical business operations every day.
  
  
The Site Operations team plays a key role in ensuring platform stability, reliability, and continuous improvement across our Digital Business landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work close to production systems, influence operational standards, and have real impact on service quality across the organization.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**SiteOps Engineer**
, you will be responsible for managing and resolving incidents and bugs across TD SYNNEX digital platforms. You'll combine hands-on technical skills with strong incident and stakeholder management, ensuring issues are triaged, investigated, communicated and resolved, with the underlying aim to prevent a re-occurance.
  
  
You'll work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Security, QA, and Business teams, acting as a key operational representative within the Digital Business unit. This role can be based
**anywhere in Europe or APJ**
(subject to local hiring entity).
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage incidents, ensuring correct triage, prioritization, investigation and resolution within SLAs
* Perform root-cause analysis and collaborate with architects and developers on technical solutions for bugs
* Ensure P1-P4 incidents are tracked, managed, and resolved within agreed SLAs
* Identify recurring issues and platform trends to reduce incident volume and improve reliability
* Act as change lead for bug fixes and operational improvements
* Maintain high-quality incident and backlog management, ensuring accurate reporting and data hygiene
* Mentor and support other SiteOps team members
* Build strong working relationships with Security, DevOps, QA, Development, UX, Architecture, and Business teams
* Continuously develop expertise in TD SYNNEX web solutions and operational processes
* Support the in-house SiteOps development team with technical debt tasks to ensure a bug free platform

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years' experience developing or supporting web solutions using C# .NET
* Solid understanding of incident and change management (ITIL v4 exposure is a plus)
* Strong knowledge of C# (.NET Framework), ASP.NET MVC, and REST APIs
* Experience using observability tools (e.g. Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus)
* Experience with log analysis tools (e.g. Datadog, Graylog, Log Analytics, AppInsights)
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments
* Proven ability to lead incidents through to resolution
* Comfortable working across distributed, multicultural teams
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)

**Nice to Have**

* Strong stakeholder-facing experience in operational or customer-impacting roles
* Experience governing and reporting on SLAs
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Relevant certifications in ITIL, cloud platforms, or observability tools

**What We Offer**
We provide competitive compensation with
**annual salary reviews.**
We value continuous learning and provide a clear progression plan.
  
  
Hybrid work (3 days at the office per week)
  
  
We provide
**comprehensive benefits**
including, paid leave, retirement plans, and more.
  
  
**Key Skills**
Ability to Coordinate, Bug Fix, Collaborating, Communication, Compuware dynaTrace, C Sharp (Programming Language), Deadline Management, Kubernetes, Operations Improvement, Teamwork
  
  
At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
  
  
**What's In It For You?**

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Consultant - Forensics - National - ASU - Forensics - Discovery - New Delhi
description:
Requisition Id: 1759062
  
  
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
  
  
**The opportunity**
: Consultant-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - New Delhi
  
  
**National :**
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
  
  
**ASU - Forensics - Discovery :**
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.
  
  
Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues — including governance, controls, culture and data insights — to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Role Overview We are looking for a Forensics Data Analyst with strong SQL and data analytics capabilities to support forensic investigations, fraud reviews, compliance assessments, and risk analytics. The role will involve extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing large datasets to identify anomalies, suspicious patterns, control gaps, and potential misconduct. Key Responsibilities
* Extract and analyze large, complex datasets using advanced SQL across multiple databases and source systems.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, and quality validation to establish reliable datasets for investigations.
* Develop sophisticated SQL queries using joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, stored procedures, and query optimization.
* Conduct forensic analytics to identify fraud indicators, unusual transactions, duplicate payments, conflicts, outliers, transaction splitting, unusual relationships, and behavioral patterns.
* Integrate and reconcile data from ERP systems, databases, flat files, and other structured or semi-structured sources.
* Develop dashboards and management reports using tools such as Power BI or similar visualization platforms.
* Document analytical logic, data lineage, assumptions, exceptions, and findings to maintain an appropriate audit trail. Required Skills
* Excellent SQL skills, including complex querying and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, data models, ETL processes, and data quality concepts.
* Hands-on experience analyzing high-volume transactional datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, relationships, and exceptions.
* Proficiency in Excel and preferably Power BI.
* Exposure to Python for data analysis and automation is desirable.
* Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
* Master of Science in Data Science
* Master of Computer Applications
* Certification in Data Analytics

**Experience**

* Data Analysis (2+ years)
* Business Intelligence (3+ years)

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: DE&A - Core - Cloud Data Engineering - AWS Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
The platform uses AWS Cognito as the authentication authority, data layer as the identity authority and retained RSA capabilities. This role delivers the AWS foundation and repeatable deployment path for React/Node.js and Spring services, cognito configurations, security profile setup. It uses prompt and context engineering for infrastructure work.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain version-controlled Terraform configurations for the approved AWS infrastructure and environments.
* Provision and manage the agreed DEV, QA, QC, IQ, STE, and PROD deployment paths as applicable.
* Configure AWS Cognito user pools and authentication settings according to approved architecture and security policies.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and controlled environment promotion.
* Review infrastructure changes for unintended impact.
* Support deployment, production onboarding, operational handoff.

**Qualifications**
AWS, AWS Cognito, Terraform, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, networking, IAM, monitoring/logging, GitHub Copilot

Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.

title: Financial Accountant
description:
**About GRI**

GRI is the independent global standard setter for sustainability impact reporting providing the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards. GRI works with businesses, regulators, investors, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders to advance transparency, accountability, and sustainable development. Through such multi-stakeholder processes, GRI develops standards that reflect global best practice and public interest.

With staff in more than 20 countries, we combine global perspective with local relevance, supporting long-term value creation for organizations and society.

**About the role**

In this role, you will assist the Finance Senior Manager in timely and accurate production of all financial information. Additionally, you will liaise with colleagues across several teams to ensure that day-to-day financial operations run smoothly and effectively.

**Responsibilities**

* Support day-to-day accounting and period-end procedures within the established deadlines by performing journal entries and ensuring their correspondence with related supporting documentation.
* Assist in preparing and compiling required information for external audits.
* Liaise with stakeholders by providing supporting documents and resolving accounting issues and discrepancies as they arise in the daily processing of transactions.
* Support accounts payable and accounts receivable related tasks.
* Assist in preparing financial and administrative reports for business lines and other stakeholders.
* Support the maintenance of the contract database.
* Assist in preparing cash reporting and bank reconciliation.
* Assist in maintaining, updating and documenting internal controls as well as the GRI’s manual for financial procedures.
* Support the preparation and execution of payments through electronic banking.
* Act as system administrator for the organization's travel and expense management platform.
* In a small team, you will also support wider finance and operational tasks as needs arise

**Work experience**

* Professional education, in finance, accounting, economics on at least Bachelor level
* Minimum 2-3 years relevant experience thorough understanding of accounting administration.
* Proven evidence of accounting and analytical skills, experience with finance software (ERPs and Microsoft Excel), detail orientation.
* Experience collaborating with colleagues, suppliers or other stakeholders across countries and cultures, with the ability to adapt communication styles and coordinate work across time zones.

* Experience with Business Central**Knowledge and abilities**
* Ability to set priorities whilst maintaining flexible and stakeholder oriented, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Able to interact and communicate clearly.
* Ability to work in a team, while also comfortable working independently and taking ownership of processes
* Fluency in English (minimum level C1 on the CEFR scale)
* Ability to deliver high-quality service.
* Ability to work in an international and multi-cultural setting.
* Affinity with the mission of GRI

**What we offer**

* Location: Remote +/- 4h CET
* Work hours: Full-time (40hrs/week)
* Contract type: 1 year with possibility of extension
* Start date: as soon as possible
* Salary benchmarked depending on location. We will share the salary range pertaining to your location of work ahead of the first interview.
* Generous leave allowance.
* Access to the GRI Academy.

The application deadline for this position is 10 November 2026 at 12:00 (noon) CEST. Applications received after this date will not be considered.
